raw_record.question_text:
Read the map and answer: To which zones among China's heat zones do southern Xinjiang and northern Xinjiang respectively belong?

<image1>
raw_record.standard_answer: Southern Xinjiang belongs to the warm temperate zone, and northern Xinjiang belongs to the middle temperate zone.

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a Xinjiang sketch map divided by the central Tianshan Mountains into South Xinjiang and North Xinjiang. Then compare their relative latitude: South Xinjiang is the lower-latitude part, North Xinjiang is the higher-latitude part. Apply the known Chinese heat-zone map: lower-latitude southern Xinjiang corresponds to the warm temperate zone, while higher-latitude northern Xinjiang corresponds to the middle temperate zone. Conclude: 南疆属暖温带，北疆属中温带。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是新疆的轮廓示意图，中部有一条大致东西向的山脉带，将新疆分成山脉以南的南疆和山脉以北的北疆，这条中部山脉对应天山。再推理：南疆位于天山以南，纬度相对较低；北疆位于天山以北，纬度相对较高。根据我国热量带分布，纬度较低的南疆对应暖温带，纬度较高的北疆对应中温带。因此，南疆属暖温带，北疆属中温带。
method.model_answer: 南疆属暖温带，北疆属中温带。
